title: Brain MRI Pipeline
subtitle: From a T1 scan to tissue maps and QC
description: An end-to-end Nipype pipeline with FSL FAST, K-means and ANTs Atropos segmentation, tissue volumes, bias-correction metrics and an interactive 3D brain.
longDescription: A research and learning pipeline for T1-weighted MRI: AC-PC alignment, MNI152 registration, skull stripping and N4 bias correction, followed by a choice of FSL FAST, K-means or ANTs Atropos. It compares segmentation agreement, reports tissue volumes and QC metrics, and produces a 3D view and HTML report per scan. Demo scans come from openly licensed OpenNeuro data.
features: AC-PC alignment, registration, skull stripping and N4 correction
Selectable FAST, K-means or Atropos segmentation
Tissue volumes, Dice agreement and before/after QC
Interactive 3D brain, turntable GIF and HTML reports
challenges: Comparing tissue segmentation methods on the same corrected scan
solutions: A focused Docker image containing the required tools
Shared N4-corrected inputs with selectable primary segmentation
results: Reproducible CPU pipeline with openly licensed demo scans
Per-scan tissue maps, quantitative QC and HTML reports
